title: Tiny Agent Program
description: Complete agent program composing the five steps: prompt, remember, iterate, skill, and command with gated execution.

steps.description: Docstring: the five steps composed into one program.
TOOL_RULE: the instruction telling the model it can run shell commands.
Load_config: reads config.json and applies OLLAMA_URL override from environment.
Chat: Step 1 prompt, handles both OpenAI-style and Ollama endpoints.
Step 2 remember: load_history and save_history for persistence.
Step 4 skill: strip_front_matter, load_skill, build_system integrate SKILL.md.
Step 5 command: gate, run_command, take_turn implement two-gate security model.
Step 3 iterate: main loop with /forget, /quit commands and memory management.
